subject.title: feat: add external archive provider sync

question: Should Slacrawl permanently support configured local JSONL archive providers as a first-class sync source and maintain its subprocess, checkpoint, and source-precedence contract?
rationale: This adds a durable configuration and archive-ingestion boundary rather than repairing established behavior; code review alone cannot decide the intended long-term support and security contract.

options.title: Approve the provider contract
options.body: Accept the opt-in local-provider direction after the branch is rebased, upgrade behavior is demonstrated, and release-owned changelog edits are removed.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Retain only the parts maintainers want to support and defer protocol or storage behaviors that should not become a public contract yet.

options.title: Defer the integration
options.body: Pause this PR if external archive ingestion should remain outside Slacrawl's supported core sync sources.

recommendation.title: Approve the provider contract
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in local-provider direction after the branch is rebased, upgrade behavior is demonstrated, and release-owned changelog edits are removed.

likelyOwner.reason: The available contribution trail connects this person to both the proposed provider path and adjacent source-sync work, though current-main ownership needs maintainer confirmation.
